messages:
Alex: Heads up — Patchwork Co. reporting ~12 failed invoice payments this morning for invoice inv_4268. EU merchant. Error types in our logs: insufficient_funds, risk_declined, 3DS_REQUIRED. Customer says card works elsewhere. invoice_id=inv_4268 merchant=patchwork-co
Rita (merchant-success): Customer screenshot shows a blank iframe where 3DS modal should appear, nothing ever prompts. They also mention PO on account so they can't approve manually. @payments please triage :eyes:
Alex: Sample gateway response from one attempt (payment_attempt_id=payatt_3321):
```
{"status":"declined","code":"3DS_REQUIRED","acquirer_response":"3DS auth required","transaction_id":"txn_9876","acquirer":"acme-psp"}
```
Shim (payments-eng): Can you paste the full payment_attempt_id and which integration the merchant uses (iframe vs redirect)? Also need raw request/response headers. Is this hosted checkout or our iframe embed?
Alex: Hosted iframe embed. payment_attempt_id=payatt_3321, raw gateway reply above. Our logs show redirect->acquirer but client never got auth_url.
Jamie (oncall): This smells like an iframe+CSP/redirect issue — if the redirect target is same-site blocked the browser won't show the modal. Check redirect handler logs: auth_redirect_handler error: 502 bad gateway when proxying to acquirer.
Shim (payments-eng): I reproduced in staging with an IE billing_country SCA flow. Staging flow returns 302 to acquirer but our iframe code was swallowing the Location and not sending auth_url back to client. Filed PR#5423 (fix: surface auth_url in JSON fallback). Canary build rolling now.
Alex: Customer is on hosted iframe — hotfix needed ASAP. These failures block downstream invoice automation (they have PO requirement so manual pay isn't an option).
Jamie (oncall): Hotfix deployed to canary. If you get a failing attempt, grab that payment_attempt_id and post it here so I can trace acquirer side. :thumbsup:
Rita (merchant-success): Shared a quick repro: switch to direct checkout link (non-iframe) to confirm it's iframe-related. Customer is trying now and will report.
billing-bot: Ticket CS-1124 created and linked to INC-2026-07. Escalated to Payments ENG.
Alex: Thanks — I'll follow up with the customer after canary verification. If they still see 'insufficient_funds' vs '3DS_REQUIRED' mix we should also check our fraud evaluation path; might be double-failing both SCA and risk checks.
Shim (payments-eng): Noted — will validate fraud-rule ordering. If risk block happens before 3DS we might be returning risk_declined instead of prompting 3DS. I'll add a test case.
Rita (merchant-success): Customer confirms direct link prompted 3DS and payment completed. So it's confirmed iframe-specific. They can accept workaround for now but want fix timeline. Can we get ETA?
Shim (payments-eng): ETA for canary->prod ~2h if canary looks good. Will update PR /deploy notes.
Alex: Great — keep me posted. Thanks all.
